annotations.text: P2 learning layer — the pages P1 does not have yet. Same tokens, type and components as the approved P1 mockups; light = Studio Precision, dark = Night Lab. Row 1: practice. Row 2: reference + bilingual reading. Row 3: AI-era prompt builder and dark checks.
AI-era affordances stay one family: the accent-2 border/colour marks the review kata, Ask-your-AI panels, rules packs and the prompt builder. Generated code in katas is illustrative and says so.

Open questions for review: (1) Flashcards: four ratings or two (Again/Good)? (2) Cheatsheet print: 2 columns A4. (3) Bilingual: paired by default, side-by-side only ≥1440px. (4) Kata: mark lines vs free-text review — mockup shows both.
